heading: Project binding and discovery
text:
### Project binding and discovery [LTSL.2.2]

The compiler discovers tests by **project membership**: beside each module the
program compiles, wherever its import resolves ([LTSL.2.4]). A test is **bound to its project**: it sees that project's schemas
and rules, and runs under the program-under-test's resolved settings
([LDIA.1.3]). A `.dstest` file has no `use` directive of its own
([LDIA.2.10.6]). Indentation, comments, and string and unit literals are DS's
([LLEX]).
